item.title: Did you know? Greenland is 14 times smaller than Africa (despite the fake size you see on maps)!
item.description: Our 2-dimensional world maps are misleading, and they enormously exaggerate the size of many territories. That includes Canada and Greenland, which look the same size as the entire African continent. Yet Greenland is 14 times smaller than Africa (Canada is 3 times smaller than Africa).
